description: Tape stop, 3HP — it slows the signal to a halt and starts it again, like taking a hand to a turntable

params.text: Starts the slowdown, from full speed down to silence over the time set by SPEED
Brings the signal back, fading it up from silence to full speed
Sets how long the slowdown takes, 0.5 to 3 seconds

inputs.text: The signal being stopped and started
A trigger here starts the slowdown
A trigger here brings the signal back
Volts here are added to the slowdown time, a volt counting as a second

outputs.text: The signal at whatever speed the brake has it at, and 0V once it has come to rest

notes: the lamp is green while the signal runs at full speed, blue while it slows or comes back, and red while it is stopped
